blocks.text: COTABATO CITY—At least three students have died in a shooting incident inside Banga National High School here at past 1 p.m. on Friday, authorities said. Banga Mayor Albert Palencia told Bombo Radyo Koronadal on Friday afternoon that the students were declared dead upon arrival at a local hospital, citing a report from the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office. One of the fatalities is believed to be the shooter who turned the gun against himself, added Palencia, who got to the school around 1:15 p.m. upon receiving a report of the incident.
